title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 开放式多智能体系统中强化学习的公理化框架

paragraphs.en: Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices. This formulation builds on a novel NAHT decomposition, which characterises the fundamental difference between open and fully controllable multi-agent systems, and establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation for learning. We further show that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs, providing a principled bridge between reinforcement learning and classical cooperative game theory. Building on this framework, we introduce Shapley Machines and Banzhaf Machines, two generic algorithmic templates that can be instantiated with standard reinforcement learning methods. When applied to strong base algorithms such as IPPO and POAM, our methods consistently improve learning efficiency and generalisation to unseen agent types and conventions across NAHT benchmark tasks. The code of experiments is published on https://github.com/hsvgbkhgbv/axiomatic-rl-naht .
paragraphs.zh: 开放多智能体系统中只有一部分智能体是可控的，这类系统在智能电网等现实领域处于核心地位，但强化学习算法设计仍缺乏一个有原则的基础。 我们通过 n 智能体临时协作（NAHT）来研究这一设定，这是一个近期提出的面向开放多智能体环境学习的框架。 我们提出一个公理化框架，从 Shapley 公理（有效性、对称性和线性性）出发推导价值函数学习，将其视为结构性约束而非启发式设计选择。 这一形式化建立在一个新颖的 NAHT 分解之上，该分解刻画了开放多智能体系统与完全可控多智能体系统之间的本质差异，并为学习建立了合作博弈论基础。 我们进一步证明，在学习个体价值函数时强制施加这些公理，可以还原 Dec-POMDP 下的 Shapley 值，从而在强化学习与经典合作博弈论之间建立起一座有原则的桥梁。 基于这一框架，我们提出了 Shapley Machines 和 Banzhaf Machines，这是两个通用的算法模板，可以用标准的强化学习方法进行实例化。 应用于 IPPO 和 POAM 等强基础算法时，我们的方法在 NAHT 基准任务上持续提升学习效率以及对未见过的智能体类型和约定的泛化能力。 实验代码已发布于 https://github.com/hsvgbkhgbv/axiomatic-rl-naht 。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) have become a central paradigm for modelling real-world domains such as smart grids ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , railway networks ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and swarm robotics ( Nayak et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , where multiple agents must coordinate under uncertainty. Reinforcement learning (RL) ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ) , and in particular cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL), has shown promise in solving such problems. However, existing CMARL methods typically assume that all agents are controllable and that team composition is fixed, which we call the closed multi-agent systems; these assumptions rarely hold in practice.

sents.en: However, existing CMARL methods typically assume that all agents are controllable and that team composition is fixed, which we call the closed multi-agent systems; these assumptions rarely hold in practice.
sents.zh: 然而，现有的CMARL方法通常假设所有智能体都是可控的，且团队构成是固定的，我们称之为封闭多智能体系统；这些假设在实践中很少成立。

paragraphs.en: In many real-world scenarios, agents must operate in open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents is controllable and the remaining agents may be unknown or dynamically changing. This setting introduces two fundamental challenges: (i) generalisation to previously unseen teammate behaviours, and (ii) openness to varying team compositions. To address these challenges, recent work has introduced the n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT) ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , which extends CMARL to settings with partially controllable and dynamically formed teams.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多现实场景中，智能体必须在开放的多智能体系统中运行，其中只有一部分智能体是可控的，其余智能体可能是未知的或动态变化的。 这一设定带来了两个根本性挑战：(i) 对先前未见过的队友行为的泛化，以及 (ii) 对不同团队组成的开放性。 为了应对这些挑战，近期工作提出了 n 智能体临时协作（NAHT）（Wang et al., 2025），它将 CMARL 扩展到部分可控且动态组建团队的设定中。

sents.en: In many real-world scenarios, agents must operate in open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents is controllable and the remaining agents may be unknown or dynamically changing.
sents.zh: 在许多现实场景中，智能体必须在开放的多智能体系统中运行，其中只有一部分智能体是可控的，其余智能体可能是未知的或动态变化的。

sents.en: This setting introduces two fundamental challenges: (i) generalisation to previously unseen teammate behaviours, and (ii) openness to varying team compositions.
sents.zh: 这一设定带来了两个根本性挑战：(i) 对先前未见过的队友行为的泛化，以及 (ii) 对不同团队组成的开放性。

sents.en: To address these challenges, recent work has introduced the n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT) ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , which extends CMARL to settings with partially controllable and dynamically formed teams.
sents.zh: 为了应对这些挑战，近期工作提出了 n 智能体临时协作（NAHT）（Wang et al., 2025），它将 CMARL 扩展到部分可控且动态组建团队的设定中。

paragraphs.en: Although the NAHT objective is to maximise the team value over varying team compositions, this objective does not specify how agents can form cooperation in an open system with both controlled and uncontrolled agents. sents.en: Although the NAHT objective is to maximise the team value over varying team compositions, this objective does not specify how agents can form cooperation in an open system with both controlled and uncontrolled agents.
sents.zh: 尽管 NAHT 的目标是在不同的团队组成下最大化团队价值，但该目标并未说明智能体如何在既有受控智能体又有非受控智能体的开放系统中形成合作。

sents.en: This raises a fundamental question:
sents.zh: 这引出了一个根本性问题：

paragraphs.en: How should individual value functions be structured and learned to support cooperation in open multi-agent systems?
paragraphs.zh: 在开放的多智能体系统中，个体价值函数应如何构建和学习，以支持协作？

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we address this question from the perspective of cooperative game theory. Specifically, we introduce an NAHT decomposition that represents a team value by two parts: internal cooperation among controlled agents and external teamwork involving uncontrolled agents. This decomposition reveals a structural distinction between open and closed multi-agent systems, which is not innately captured by the NAHT objective.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们从合作博弈论的视角来回答这一问题。 具体而言，我们引入了一种 NAHT 分解，将团队价值表示为两部分：受控智能体之间的内部合作，以及涉及非受控智能体的外部协作。 该分解揭示了开放多智能体系统与封闭多智能体系统之间的结构性区别，而这一区别并未被 NAHT 目标函数天然地捕捉到。

sents.en: In this paper, we address this question from the perspective of cooperative game theory.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们从合作博弈论的视角来回答这一问题。

sents.en: Specifically, we introduce an NAHT decomposition that represents a team value by two parts: internal cooperation among controlled agents and external teamwork involving uncontrolled agents.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们引入了一种 NAHT 分解，将团队价值表示为两部分：受控智能体之间的内部合作，以及涉及非受控智能体的外部协作。

sents.en: This decomposition reveals a structural distinction between open and closed multi-agent systems, which is not innately captured by the NAHT objective.
sents.zh: 该分解揭示了开放多智能体系统与封闭多智能体系统之间的结构性区别，而这一区别并未被 NAHT 目标函数天然地捕捉到。

paragraphs.en: Building on this structure, we propose an axiomatic framework to derive individual value functions, grounded in the axioms of the Shapley value ( Shapley, 1953 ; Dubey, 1975 ) . Rather than constructing individual value functions directly by the explicit form of the Shapley value, we derive the individual value function learning by enforcing its axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity) as structural constraints. This yields a principled approach to designing learning algorithms, where individual value functions are shaped to satisfy some properties, such as cooperative game-theoretic properties applied in this paper. Notably, we prove in theory that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs ( Oliehoek et al., 2016 ) , while relaxing specific axioms leads to alternative payoff allocations, such as the Banzhaf index.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一结构，我们提出一个公理化框架来推导个体价值函数，其基础是 Shapley 值的公理（Shapley, 1953；Dubey, 1975）。 我们不是通过 Shapley 值的显式形式直接构造个体价值函数，而是通过将其公理（有效性、对称性和线性性）作为结构性约束加以强制执行，来推导个体价值函数的学习。 这为设计学习算法提供了一种有原则的方法，其中个体价值函数被塑造成满足某些性质，例如本文所应用的博弈论合作性质。 值得注意的是，我们在理论上证明，在学习个体价值函数时强制执行这些公理可以恢复 Dec-POMDP（Oliehoek et al., 2016）的 Shapley 值，而放松特定公理则会导致其他收益分配方式，例如 Banzhaf 指数。

sents.en: Building on this structure, we propose an axiomatic framework to derive individual value functions, grounded in the axioms of the Shapley value ( Shapley, 1953 ; Dubey, 1975 ) .

sents.zh: 这为设计学习算法提供了一种有原则的方法，其中个体价值函数被塑造成满足某些性质，例如本文所应用的博弈论合作性质。

sents.en: Notably, we prove in theory that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs ( Oliehoek et al., 2016 ) , while relaxing specific axioms leads to alternative payoff allocations, such as the Banzhaf index.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，我们在理论上证明，在学习个体价值函数时强制执行这些公理可以恢复 Dec-POMDP（Oliehoek et al., 2016）的 Shapley 值，而放松特定公理则会导致其他收益分配方式，例如 Banzhaf 指数。

paragraphs.en: More importantly, our axiomatic framework also reveals a novel connection between cooperative game theory and reinforcement learning. In particular, we show that the Linearity axiom induces a structure equivalent to the truncated TD( λ \lambda ) ( Cichosz, 1994 ) , where the number of n n -step return components can be estimated by the number of non-empty coalitions of cooperative games. This provides a theoretical explanation for the role of n n -step returns and suggests a new perspective on the design of temporal-difference learning methods in the NAHT (see Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 更重要的是，我们的公理化框架还揭示了合作博弈论与强化学习之间的一种新颖联系。 具体而言，我们证明了线性公理导出的结构等价于截断的 TD( λ \lambda ) ( Cichosz, 1994 )，其中 n n 步回报分量的数量可以通过合作博弈中非空联盟的数量来估计。 这为 n n 步回报的作用提供了理论解释，并为 NAHT 中时序差分学习方法的设计提出了新的视角（见第 5.2 节）。

sents.en: In particular, we show that the Linearity axiom induces a structure equivalent to the truncated TD( λ \lambda ) ( Cichosz, 1994 ) , where the number of n n -step return components can be estimated by the number of non-empty coalitions of cooperative games.

sents.en: This provides a theoretical explanation for the role of n n -step returns and suggests a new perspective on the design of temporal-difference learning methods in the NAHT (see Section 5.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Since NAHT includes single-agent RL with an environment of other uncontrolled agents and CMARL with fully controllable agents as its two extreme cases, the above result also extends to both settings.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 NAHT 将单智能体强化学习（环境由其他不可控智能体构成）和完全可控智能体的 CMARL 作为其两个极端情形，因此上述结果同样适用于这两种设定。

paragraphs.en: Based on this axiomatic framework, we introduce two generic algorithmic templates: Shapley Machines, which enforce all axioms, and Banzhaf Machines, which relax the Efficiency axiom. These templates can be instantiated with existing RL algorithms, such as IPPO ( De Witt et al., 2020 ) and POAM, to yield practical methods for solving the NAHT.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一公理化框架，我们提出两个通用算法模板：强制满足所有公理的 Shapley Machines（沙普利机），以及放宽效率公理的 Banzhaf Machines（班扎夫机）。 这些模板可以用现有的强化学习算法（如 IPPO（De Witt et al., 2020）和 POAM）进行实例化，从而得到解决 NAHT 问题的实用方法。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the proposed methods on modified MPE and SMAC benchmarks adapted to the NAHT setting ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Our results show that the proposed framework consistently improves learning efficiency and generalisation to unseen agent types and conventions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that relaxing specific axioms can lead to improved performance in certain regimes, highlighting the flexibility of the proposed axiomatic perspective. Due to the limit of space, we leave the related work section to Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe a problem setting for open multi-agent systems, referred to as n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT) ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . The main challenges of NAHT are as follows: (1) cooperating with potentially unknown types of teammates (generalization), and (2) coping with a varying number of uncontrolled teammates (openness). A decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (Dec-POMDP) ( Oliehoek et al., 2016 ) is considered to formalize the problem. There is a team of agents ℳ \mathcal{M} whose size is denoted as M M , a state space 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , a joint action space 𝒜 = × i ∈ ℳ 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}=\times_{i\in\mathcal{M}}\mathcal{A}_{i} , a per-agent observation space 𝒪 i \mathcal{O}_{i} , a transition function P T : 𝒮 × 𝒜 → Δ ⁡ ( 𝒮 ) P_{T}:\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}\rightarrow\Delta(\mathcal{S}) , a common reward function R t : 𝒮 × 𝒜 → ℝ R_{t}:\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}\rightarrow\mathbb{R} , a discount factor γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in[0,1] and an episode length T ∈ ℤ + T\in\mathbb{Z}^{+} . Each agent receives observations via an observation function O i : 𝒮 × 𝒜 → Δ ⁡ ( 𝒪 i ) O_{i}:\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}\rightarrow\Delta(\mathcal{O}_{i}) . ℋ i \mathcal{H}_{i} is defined as an agent i i ’s space of observation and action histories. Each agent is equipped with a policy π i : ℋ i → Δ ⁡ ( 𝒜 i ) \pi_{i}:\mathcal{H}_{i}\rightarrow\Delta(\mathcal{A}_{i}) .

Shapley value is a multidimensional linear transformation ϕ : 𝒢 → ℝ M \phi:\mathcal{G}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{M} defined on the set of cooperative game 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , given that there are M M agents in total. paragraphs.en: To understand how learning differs in open multi-agent systems, we first characterise the cooperative-game structure of team values of the NAHT. Recall that in the NAHT a team consists of two groups of agents: a set of controlled agents 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , whose policies are optimized, and a set of uncontrolled agents 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , whose behaviours are unknown and may vary across episodes. Unlike the closed multi-agent systems, the performance of a team in the NAHT depends not only on coordination among controlled agents, but also on their ability to adapt to diverse and potentially unseen teammates. To make this distinction explicit, we represent a team value at a given state in the NAHT as a state-specific cooperative game that is the weighted sum of non-empty coalition basis games, from the perspective of cooperative game theory, as follows:

paragraphs.en: Implication. This decomposition highlights a fundamental difference between NAHT and CMARL: In the CMARL, all agents are controllable, and learning focuses exclusively on internal cooperation. In the NAHT, learning must additionally account for external teamwork with uncontrolled agents. Ignoring the external component effectively reduces the problem to a closed multi-agent system, which introduces bias and limits generalisation to unseen team compositions. The NAHT decomposition therefore provides a structural characterisation of openness, and it will serve as the foundation for the axiomatic framework introduced as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 启示。 这一分解凸显了 NAHT 与 CMARL 之间的一个根本差异：在 CMARL 中，所有智能体都是可控的，学习仅专注于内部合作。 而在 NAHT 中，学习还必须额外考虑与不可控智能体之间的外部协作。 忽略外部部分实际上会把该问题退化为一个封闭的多智能体系统，这会引入偏差，并限制其在未见过的团队组成上的泛化能力。 因此，NAHT 的分解提供了一种对开放性的结构性刻画，并将作为下文引入的公理化框架的基础。

paragraphs.en: Building on the NAHT decomposition, we now derive an axiomatic framework for learning in open multi-agent systems. Our approach is based on the axioms of the Shapley value, which we interpret as structural constraints on individual value functions. In detail, we aim to show that how the individual values, as the output of a multidimensional linear transformation ϕ \phi applied on a team value (represented as a cooperative game), satisfy the Shapley value’s axioms in learning. When we enforce all these axioms together, the Shapley-form individual values are uniquely shaped (see Theorem 4.7 ). Moreover, the axioms can be directly translated into algorithmic design principles: (1) The Efficiency axiom corresponds to reward shaping; (2) The Linearity axiom corresponds to truncated TD( λ \lambda )-style updates; (3) The Symmetry axiom corresponds to individual value function structures. These principles will later lead to two generic algorithmic templates, referred to as Shapley Machine and Banzhaf Machine.
paragraphs.zh: 在NAHT分解的基础上，我们如今推导出一个用于开放多智能体系统学习的公理化框架。 我们的方法基于Shapley值的公理，我们将其解释为对个体价值函数的结构性约束。 具体而言，我们旨在证明：作为多维线性变换 ϕ \phi 作用于团队价值（表示为合作博弈）的输出，个体价值如何在学习中满足Shapley值的公理。 当我们同时强制实施所有这些公理时，Shapley形式的个体价值被唯一地确定（见定理4.7）。 此外，这些公理可以直接转化为算法设计原则：(1) 有效性公理对应于奖励塑形；(2) 线性公理对应于截断的TD( λ \lambda )式更新；(3) 对称性公理对应于个体价值函数结构。 这些原则稍后将引出两个通用算法模板，分别称为Shapley机器（Shapley Machine）和Banzhaf机器（Banzhaf Machine）。

sents.en: In detail, we aim to show that how the individual values, as the output of a multidimensional linear transformation ϕ \phi applied on a team value (represented as a cooperative game), satisfy the Shapley value’s axioms in learning.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们旨在证明：作为多维线性变换 ϕ \phi 作用于团队价值（表示为合作博弈）的输出，个体价值如何在学习中满足Shapley值的公理。

sents.en: When we enforce all these axioms together, the Shapley-form individual values are uniquely shaped (see Theorem 4.7 ).
sents.zh: 当我们同时强制实施所有这些公理时，Shapley形式的个体价值被唯一地确定（见定理4.7）。

sents.en: Moreover, the axioms can be directly translated into algorithmic design principles: (1) The Efficiency axiom corresponds to reward shaping; (2) The Linearity axiom corresponds to truncated TD( λ \lambda )-style updates; (3) The Symmetry axiom corresponds to individual value function structures.
sents.zh: 此外，这些公理可以直接转化为算法设计原则：(1) 有效性公理对应于奖励塑形；(2) 线性公理对应于截断的TD( λ \lambda )式更新；(3) 对称性公理对应于个体价值函数结构。

sents.en: These principles will later lead to two generic algorithmic templates, referred to as Shapley Machine and Banzhaf Machine.
sents.zh: 这些原则稍后将引出两个通用算法模板，分别称为Shapley机器（Shapley Machine）和Banzhaf机器（Banzhaf Machine）。

paragraphs.en: Shapley Machine is an algorithm enforcing V i V_{i} to fulfil Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity, so the V i V_{i} is the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs.
paragraphs.zh: Shapley 机器是一种强制 V i V_{i} 满足效率性（Efficiency）、对称性（Symmetry）和线性性（Linearity）的算法，因此 V i V_{i} 就是 Dec-POMDP 的 Shapley 值。

paragraphs.en: To realize the Shapley Machine, we use two base algorithms structurally satisfying the Symmetry axiom: POAM ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and IPPO ( De Witt et al., 2020 ) . We then shape the objective functions following conditions imposed by other two axioms, to obtain the algorithms SM-POAM and SM-IPPO , respectively. The details of implementation are left to Appendix H.1 .

paragraphs.en: Following the same principle of designing algorithms via axiomatic characterization, we also propose a variant that enforces the Linearity and Symmetry axioms while omitting Efficiency. Since the resulting V i V_{i} aligns with the Banzhaf index, we call this algorithm Banzhaf Machine . Analogous to the implementation of Shapley Machine, its instantiation on POAM and IPPO are named as BM-POAM and BM-IPPO , respectively.

paragraphs.en: In experiments, we evaluate the proposed SM-POAM, SM-IPPO, BM-POAM and BM-IPPO on the modified MPE-PP and SMAC benchmark tasks tailored to the NAHT settings ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , against the counterpart baseline algorithms POAM and IPPO. The uncontrolled agents are taken from five pre-trained policies, which were trained in fully controllable CMARL settings using the algorithms IPPO, MAPPO, VDN, QMIX, and IQL. To avoid confusion between the standard IPPO algorithm (trained under the CMARL settings) and the version trained within the NAHT process (where only a subset of agents is controllable), we refer to the latter as IPPO-NAHT.
paragraphs.zh: 在实验中，我们在针对NAHT设置（Wang et al., 2025）改造的MPE-PP和SMAC基准任务上，将所提出的SM-POAM、SM-IPPO、BM-POAM和BM-IPPO与对应的基线算法POAM和IPPO进行评估比较。 不受控的智能体来自五个预训练策略，这些策略在完全可控的CMARL设置下分别使用IPPO、MAPPO、VDN、QMIX和IQL算法训练得到。 为避免标准的IPPO算法（在CMARL设置下训练）与在NAHT过程中训练的版本（其中只有一部分智能体可控）之间产生混淆，我们将后者称为IPPO-NAHT。

paragraphs.en: More importantly, we validate the game structure for the NAHT, a core concept in our theory, by setting the number of n n -step return components considered in TTD( λ \lambda ) using the number of basis games m m . In practice, the horizon in our theoretical framework is the episode length. Since the number of basis games is far more than the preset episode length (511 vs. 150) in 10v11, we approximate the number of basis games to the episode length as a trade-off. About the 8v9 scenario, the number of basis games needed in theory is close to the episode length (127 vs. 120), so the number of basis games can be naturally approximated by the episode length. As a result, for 8v9 and 10v11 Banzhaf Machine is equivalent to the baseline counterparts in implementation. The details of baselines, experimental settings and evaluation metrics are provided in Appendix H . All results are obtained by first computing each metric with 128 episodes and then averaging these per-seed metrics across 5 random seeds, with 95% confidence intervals reported.
paragraphs.zh: 更重要的是，我们通过使用基博弈的数量 m m 来设置 TTD( λ \lambda ) 中考虑的 n n 步回报分量的数量，从而验证了 NAHT 这一我们理论中的核心概念的博弈结构。 在实践中，我们理论框架中的时域范围即为回合长度。 由于基博弈的数量远大于 10v11 中预设的回合长度（511 对 150），我们作为一种折中将基博弈的数量近似为回合长度。 对于 8v9 场景，理论上所需的基博弈数量已接近回合长度（127 对 120），因此基博弈的数量可以自然地用回合长度来近似。 因此，在实现上，8v9 和 10v11 的 Banzhaf Machine 与对应的基线方法是等价的。 基线方法、实验设置和评估指标的详细信息见附录 H。 所有结果均先通过 128 个回合计算每个指标，然后对 5 个随机种子的逐种子指标取平均，并报告 95% 置信区间。

paragraphs.en: Research Questions. We focus on the following research questions in experimentation: (1) Is the number of coalitions m m used to decide the horizon of TTD( λ \lambda ) (see Section 4.2 ) a reasonable choice? (2) Are all Shapley value’s axioms equally appropriate across scenarios? (3) Which axiom is key to generalization to unseen conventions or unseen agent types?

paragraphs.en: Answer to Question 1. We conduct experiments with varying numbers of basis games m m using SM-POAM as the candidate algorithm. As shown in Figure 2 , learning performance in MPE-PP and 8v9 is sensitive to the choice of m m , while in 5v6 it is comparatively robust. Overall, these results indicate that setting the number of n n -step return components as the number of non-empty coalition basis games can nearly maximize learning performance, thereby providing an empirical evidence to support the mathematical rationale behind the Linearity axiom that derives this setting for the NAHT. Although we do not deny that there may exist other preferred choices of m m (as observed in the results of MPE-PP and 5v6), this does not undermine the effectiveness of using the number of non-empty coalition basis games, as a criterion, to decide the horizon for TTD( λ \lambda ) in practice.

paragraphs.en: Answer to Question 2. We evaluate all baselines alongside our proposed algorithms. For the large-scale tasks 8v9 and 10v11, the base algorithms IPPO-NAHT and POAM are effectively equivalent to BM-IPPO and BM-POAM under the approximation of m m due to limited episode lengths, and are therefore omitted in implementation. Figure 3 shows that, for either IPPO-NAHT or POAM, at least one of their Shapley Machine or Banzhaf Machine variants achieves the best performance. Recall that Banzhaf Machine corresponds to dropping the Efficiency axiom. In MPE-PP and 3sv5z with IPPO-NAHT as the base algorithm, Banzhaf Machine performs on par with Shapley Machine. In most other scenarios (except 10v11 with IPPO-NAHT), Shapley Machine outperforms Banzhaf Machine, although sometimes by a narrow margin. Moreover, comparisons between the base algorithms and their Banzhaf counterparts in MPE-PP, 5v6, and 3sv5z underscore the importance of the Linearity axiom. Overall, the results suggest that all three Shapley axioms generally enhance learning performance (in possibly unseen team compositions), but the Efficiency axiom can, in some cases, reduce it. This justifies the value of our proposed axiomatic framework, which provides a novel perspective on analysing performance through the falsifiable axioms. We believe that this axiomatic framework, as a paradigm, can help design new algorithms in the future.

paragraphs.en: Answer to Question 3. We evaluate all baselines alongside our proposed algorithms after training, to test their capability of generalization to unseen conventions and unseen agent types, respectively. The evaluation is conducted by the best model saved during training for each random seed of running experiments. Note that the wide range of confidence intervals is due to that the result averages performance across various number of controlled agents, and we further demonstrate the result per the number of controlled agents in Appendix I.5 . paragraphs.en: We studied reinforcement learning (RL) in open multi-agent systems through the lens of the n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), and introduced a cooperative game-theoretic framework that makes explicit how openness is distinguished from the cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL). Central to our approach is the NAHT decomposition, which separates internal cooperation among controlled agents from external teamwork with uncontrolled agents. Building on this structure, we proposed an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry, and Linearity) by enforcing them as structural constraints. This perspective shifts the design of RL algorithms from heuristic constructions to principled designs in the NAHT. Since CMARL is an extreme case of the NAHT, our framework also works on it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过n智能体临时团队协作（NAHT）的视角研究了开放多智能体系统中的强化学习（RL），并提出了一个合作博弈论框架，明确区分了开放性与合作式多智能体强化学习（CMARL）的差异。 我们方法的核心是NAHT分解，它将被控智能体之间的内部合作与不可控智能体之间的外部团队协作分离开来。 在此结构基础上，我们提出了一个公理化框架，通过将沙普利公理（有效性、对称性和线性性）作为结构性约束来实施，从而推导出价值函数学习。 这一视角将NAHT中强化学习算法的设计从启发式构造转变为有原则的设计。 由于CMARL是NAHT的极端情形，我们的框架同样适用于CMARL。

sents.en: We studied reinforcement learning (RL) in open multi-agent systems through the lens of the n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), and introduced a cooperative game-theoretic framework that makes explicit how openness is distinguished from the cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL).
sents.zh: 我们通过n智能体临时团队协作（NAHT）的视角研究了开放多智能体系统中的强化学习（RL），并提出了一个合作博弈论框架，明确区分了开放性与合作式多智能体强化学习（CMARL）的差异。

sents.en: Central to our approach is the NAHT decomposition, which separates internal cooperation among controlled agents from external teamwork with uncontrolled agents.
sents.zh: 我们方法的核心是NAHT分解，它将被控智能体之间的内部合作与不可控智能体之间的外部团队协作分离开来。

sents.en: Building on this structure, we proposed an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry, and Linearity) by enforcing them as structural constraints.
sents.zh: 在此结构基础上，我们提出了一个公理化框架，通过将沙普利公理（有效性、对称性和线性性）作为结构性约束来实施，从而推导出价值函数学习。

sents.en: This perspective shifts the design of RL algorithms from heuristic constructions to principled designs in the NAHT.
sents.zh: 这一视角将NAHT中强化学习算法的设计从启发式构造转变为有原则的设计。

sents.en: Since CMARL is an extreme case of the NAHT, our framework also works on it.
sents.zh: 由于CMARL是NAHT的极端情形，我们的框架同样适用于CMARL。

paragraphs.en: Our framework also reveals a novel connection between cooperative game theory and reinforcement learning: The Linearity axiom provides a theoretical explanation for the n n -step return methods and the TTD( λ \lambda ) in the NAHT. This result is coincidentally related to the latest finding in single-agent offline RL that the n n -step return methods with selected horizons can improve scalability to the increasing size of datasets ( Park et al., 2026 ) . As the NAHT encompasses the case of single-agent RL with other unknown agents, our framework suggests that, through the TTD( λ \lambda ), the increasing size of datasets could be a promising way to address the NAHT, which is left for the future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的框架还揭示了合作博弈论与强化学习之间的一个新颖联系：线性公理为 NAHT 中的 n 步回报方法和 TTD(λ) 提供了理论解释。 这一结果恰好与单智能体离线强化学习中的最新发现相关联，即采用选定跨度的 n 步回报方法可以提升对数据集规模不断增长的可扩展性（Park et al., 2026）。 由于 NAHT 涵盖了单智能体强化学习与其他未知智能体共存的情形，我们的框架表明，通过 TTD(λ)，不断增长的数据集规模可能是解决 NAHT 的一种有前景的途径，这一点留待未来工作研究。

sents.en: Our framework also reveals a novel connection between cooperative game theory and reinforcement learning: The Linearity axiom provides a theoretical explanation for the n n -step return methods and the TTD( λ \lambda ) in the NAHT.
sents.zh: 我们的框架还揭示了合作博弈论与强化学习之间的一个新颖联系：线性公理为 NAHT 中的 n 步回报方法和 TTD(λ) 提供了理论解释。

sents.en: This result is coincidentally related to the latest finding in single-agent offline RL that the n n -step return methods with selected horizons can improve scalability to the increasing size of datasets ( Park et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Related work on temporal-difference learning with eligibility traces centers on the seminal TD( λ \lambda ) algorithm proposed by Sutton [1988] , which unified one-step TD and Monte Carlo methods via a trace-decay parameter λ \lambda and introduced the forward- and backward-view equivalence for efficient multi-step credit assignment. Subsequent theoretical analyses [ Dayan, 1992 , Dayan and Sejnowski, 1994 , Tsitsiklis and Van Roy, 1996 ] established convergence guarantees and characterized the bias-variance trade-off inherent in λ \lambda -returns, while extensions by Watkins and others [1989] , Peng and Williams [1994] adapted eligibility traces for off-policy control, Q( λ \lambda ). Advances in function approximation, including true online TD( λ \lambda ) [ Seijen and Sutton, 2014 ] and gradient-TD methods, further broadened applicability to large-scale and nonlinear settings, inspiring n n -step return techniques such as generalized advantage estimation (GAE) [ Schulman et al., 2015 ] for policy optimization. In the multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), algorithms of PPO family such as MAPPO [ Yu et al., 2022 ] and IPPO [ De Witt et al., 2020 ] , applied GAE to optimize policies and thus used the TD( λ \lambda ) as the target values to train critics. Our work highlights the theoretical link between the truncated TD( λ \lambda ), denoted as TTD( λ \lambda ) [ Cichosz, 1994 ] , in the NAHT and the Linearity axiom of the Shapley value. It further shows that the number of n n -step return components in the TTD( λ \lambda ) can be estimated by the number of non-empty coalition basis games. This insight provides a theoretical foundation that can inform the design of a broader class of MARL algorithms.
paragraphs.zh: 关于采用资格迹的时间差分学习的相关研究，主要围绕 Sutton [1988] 提出的开创性 TD( \lambda ) 算法展开，该算法通过迹衰减参数 \lambda 统一了单步 TD 与蒙特卡洛方法，并引入了前向视图与后向视图的等价性，以实现高效的多步信用分配。 后续的理论分析 [ Dayan, 1992 , Dayan and Sejnowski, 1994 , Tsitsiklis and Van Roy, 1996 ] 建立了收敛性保证，并刻画了 \lambda -回报中固有的偏差-方差权衡，而 Watkins 等人 [1989] 以及 Peng and Williams [1994] 的扩展工作则将资格迹适配到离策略控制中，即 Q( \lambda )。 函数逼近方面的进展，包括真正的在线 TD( \lambda ) [ Seijen and Sutton, 2014 ] 与梯度 TD 方法，进一步拓宽了其在大规模与非线性场景中的适用性，并启发了诸如广义优势估计（GAE）[ Schulman et al., 2015 ] 等用于策略优化的 n 步回报技术。 在多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，PPO 家族的算法，如 MAPPO [ Yu et al., 2022 ] 与 IPPO [ De Witt et al., 2020 ] ，应用 GAE 来优化策略，从而使用 TD( \lambda ) 作为目标值来训练评论家网络。 我们的工作突出了 NAHT 中截断的 TD( \lambda )（记作 TTD( \lambda )）[ Cichosz, 1994 ] 与 Shapley 值的线性公理之间的理论联系。 本文进一步表明，TTD( \lambda ) 中 n 步回报分量的数量可以通过非空联盟基博弈的数量来估计。 这一洞见提供了一个理论基础，可以为更广泛的一类 MARL 算法的设计提供指导。

paragraphs.en: We now discuss theoretical models describing the ad hoc teamwork (AHT). Brafman and Tennenholtz [1996] pioneered research into the AHT by investigating repeated matrix games involving a single teammate. Subsequent studies expanded this framework to scenarios with multiple teammates, notably by Agmon and Stone [2012] . Later, Agmon et al. [2014] further relaxed earlier assumptions by allowing teammates’ policies to be selected from a known set. Stone and Kraus [2010] initially formalized the AHT through collaborative multi-armed bandits, albeit under notable assumptions such as prior knowledge of teammates’ policies and environmental conditions. Albrecht and Ramamoorthy [2013] advanced this field significantly by introducing the stochastic Bayesian game (SBG), the first comprehensive theoretical framework accommodating dynamic environments and unknown teammate behaviours in the AHT. Building on the SBG, Rahman et al. [2021] proposed the open stochastic Bayesian game (OSBG), addressing the open ad hoc teamwork (OAHT). Zintgraf et al. [2021] modelled the AHT through interactive Bayesian reinforcement learning (IBRL) within Markov games, specifically targeting non-stationary teammate policies within single episodes. Xie et al. [2021] introduced the hidden parameter Markov decision process (HiP-MDP) to handle situations where teammates’ policies vary across episodes but remain stationary during individual episodes. Most recently, Wang et al. [2024] extended the OSBG by incorporating principles from cooperative game theory, introducing the open stochastic Bayesian coalitional affinity game (OSBG-CAG), which theoretically justifies a graph-based representation for joint Q-value functions and includes rigorous convergence proofs for Q-learning algorithms in open team settings. Our work adopts the perspective of cooperative game theory, introducing an NAHT decomposition based on state-specific cooperative games to address the NAHT. This well captures the structural difference between the CMARL and the NAHT. Based on the NAHT decomposition, we derive an axiomatic framework to address the NAHT, which introduces a novel perspective for solving this problem. The key difference in assumptions between the work by Wang et al. [2024] and our work is that: the work by Wang et al. [2024] was built on the non-transferable utility games, while our work is built on the transferable utility games.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在讨论描述临时团队协作（AHT）的理论模型。 Brafman 和 Tennenholtz [1996] 通过研究涉及单个队友的重复矩阵博弈，开创了 AHT 的研究。 后续研究将该框架扩展到多队友场景，其中以 Agmon 和 Stone [2012] 的工作最为著名。随后，Agmon 等人 [2014] 进一步放宽了早期假设，允许从已知集合中选择队友的策略。 Stone 和 Kraus [2010] 最初通过协作式多臂老虎机对 AHT 进行了形式化，但存在明显的假设，例如预先知晓队友策略和环境条件。 Albrecht 和 Ramamoorthy [2013] 通过引入随机贝叶斯博弈（SBG）显著推动了该领域的发展，这是首个能够容纳 AHT 中动态环境和未知队友行为的综合性理论框架。 在 SBG 的基础上，Rahman 等人 [2021] 提出了开放随机贝叶斯博弈（OSBG），以解决开放临时团队协作（OAHT）问题。Zintgraf 等人 [2021] 在马尔可夫博弈中通过交互式贝叶斯强化学习（IBRL）对 AHT 进行建模，专门针对单个回合内非平稳的队友策略。Xie 等人 [2021] 引入隐参数马尔可夫决策过程（HiP-MDP）来处理队友策略在回合之间变化但在单个回合内保持平稳的情形。 最近，Wang 等人 [2024] 通过融入合作博弈论的原理扩展了 OSBG，提出了开放随机贝叶斯联盟亲和博弈（OSBG-CAG），该工作从理论上论证了联合 Q 值函数的基于图的表示，并针对开放团队环境下的 Q 学习算法给出了严格的收敛性证明。 我们的工作采用合作博弈论的视角，引入基于特定状态合作博弈的 NAHT 分解来解决 NAHT 问题。 这很好地刻画了 CMARL 与 NAHT 之间的结构性差异。 基于 NAHT 分解，我们推导出一个用于解决 NAHT 的公理化框架，为解决该问题引入了一种全新的视角。 Wang 等人的工作与我们工作在假设上的关键差异在于：Wang 等人的 [2024] 工作建立在不可转移效用博弈之上，而我们的 [2024] 工作则建立在可转移效用博弈之上。

paragraphs.en: Early studies [ Wang et al., 2020 ] incorporated the Shapley value into credit assignment scheme in a principled way and proposed an algorithm named as SQDDPG, underpinned by the equivalence between cooperative-game theoretical models in dynamic scenarios and the team reward Markov game. Wang et al. [2022] further improved the theory by proving the existence of the Shapley value under the team reward Markov game through construction, and proposed an algorithm, relying on the construction, named as SHAQ — an algorithm with promising convergence to find an optimal joint policy. It also shed light on the relationship between the Shapley value and the relevant value decomposition and credit assignment approaches for the CMARL. Li et al. [2021] improved the stability of SQDDPG and proposed an algorithm named Shapley Counterfactual Credits. Han et al. [2022] incorporated the Shapley value into the model-based PPO as each agent’s advantage value, through the estimated coalition values by trained transition and reward models. Chai et al. [2024] continued the idea from Han et al. [2022] , by replacing the transition and reward models with more powerful world models. On the other hand, Xue et al. [2022] incorporated the Shapley value into multi-agent communication, as a criterion for forming communication between agents. One of our work’s aims is learning the Shapley value to address the NAHT, a generalized problem to the CMARL. More importantly, the Shapley value is learned by satisfying its axioms, rather than by constructing their explicit formulas as implemented in the previous work. This may help overcome the notorious learning instability issues caused by learning substantial “coalitional values” in the existing algorithms based on the Shapley value. Furthermore, the insight of axiomatic characterization can facilitate improving the flexibility of the Shapley value approaches in a wide variety of tasks. Specifically, one can safely drop any part of a learning algorithm, if it is justified that the targeting task does not align with the corresponding axiom.
paragraphs.zh: 早期研究 [Wang et al., 2020] 以一种有原则的方式将 Shapley 值引入信用分配方案，并提出了名为 SQDDPG 的算法，该算法以动态场景中的合作博弈理论模型与团队奖励马尔可夫博弈之间的等价性为支撑。Wang et al. [2022] 进一步完善了该理论，通过构造性证明证明了团队奖励马尔可夫博弈下 Shapley 值的存在性，并基于该构造提出了一种名为 SHAQ 的算法——该算法在寻找最优联合策略方面具有可观的收敛性。 它还揭示了 Shapley 值与 CMARL 中相关的值分解和信用分配方法之间的关系。Li et al. [2021] 改进了 SQDDPG 的稳定性，并提出了一种名为 Shapley 反事实信用的算法。Han et al. [2022] 将 Shapley 值引入基于模型的 PPO 中，作为每个智能体的优势值，其通过训练好的转移模型和奖励模型所估计的联盟值来实现。Chai et al. [2024] 延续了 Han et al. [2022] 的思路，用更强大的世界模型替代了转移模型和奖励模型。 另一方面，Xue et al. [2022] 将 Shapley 值引入多智能体通信中，作为智能体之间建立通信的准则。 我们工作的目标之一是学习 Shapley 值以解决 NAHT，它是 CMARL 的一个推广问题。 更重要的是，Shapley 值是通过满足其公理来学习的，而不是像先前工作那样通过构造其显式公式来获得。 这可能有助于克服现有基于 Shapley 值的算法中因学习大量“联盟值”而导致的臭名昭著的学习不稳定问题。 此外，公理化刻画的洞察可以促进提高 Shapley 值方法在各类任务中的灵活性。 具体而言，如果能够证明目标任务与相应公理不相符，就可以放心地舍弃学习算法中的任何部分。

In contrast, if λ = 0 \lambda=0 , then the λ \lambda -return reduces to G t : t + 1 G_{t:t+1} , the one-step return. Previous work in the CMARL [ Wang et al., 2020 ] has shown the equivalence on the task objective function between the state-based superadditive games with action spaces and the team reward Markov games with coalition structures. 6 6 6 In Wang et al. [2020] , state-based convex games with action spaces were proved to be equivalent to team reward Markov games. However, setting C ∩ D = ∅ C\cap D=\emptyset can relax a convex game to a superadditive game. Intuitively, the Shapley value is a solution to the stability of a team formation, resembling cooperation. Since the NAHT is a generalization of the CMARL, this conclusion is still valid in principle. paragraphs.en: Efficiency and Symmetry have been well investigated in the literature of multi-agent reinforcement learning [ Wang et al., 2020 , Li et al., 2021 , Han et al., 2022 , Wang et al., 2022 , Chai et al., 2024 ] , but Additivity still lacks attention. In detail, Additivity means that ϕ ⁡ ( w 1 + w 2 ) = ϕ ⁡ ( w 1 ) + ϕ ⁡ ( w 2 ) \phi(w_{1}+w_{2})=\phi(w_{1})+\phi(w_{2}) , for any cooperative games w 1 , w 2 ∈ 𝒢 w_{1},w_{2}\in\mathcal{G} . If we consider m m possible games, then we have the following expression: ϕ ⁡ ( ∑ i = 1 m w i ) = ∑ i = 1 m ϕ ⁡ ( w i ) \phi(\sum_{i=1}^{m}w_{i})=\sum_{i=1}^{m}\phi(w_{i}) , where w 1 , w 2 , … , w m ∈ 𝒢 w_{1},w_{2},...,w_{m}\in\mathcal{G} and the sum ∑ i = 1 m w i \sum_{i=1}^{m}w_{i} can be seen as a game reproduced by the above games. Linearity is a stronger condition than Additivity [ Dubey, 1975 , Young, 1985 ] . Specifically, Linearity requires ϕ ⁡ ( ∑ i = 1 m α i ​ w i ) = ∑ i = 1 m α i ​ ϕ ​ ( w i ) \phi(\sum_{i=1}^{m}\alpha_{i}w_{i})=\sum_{i=1}^{m}\alpha_{i}\phi(w_{i}) , for all α i ∈ ℝ \alpha_{i}\in\mathbb{R} . In contrast, Additivity only requires to satisfy the above equation when α i = 1 \alpha_{i}=1 . In our work, we use the Linearity axiom to establish the Additivity axiom, to adapt to our derivation.
paragraphs.zh: 效率性（Efficiency）与对称性（Symmetry）在多智能体强化学习的文献中已得到充分研究 [Wang et al., 2020, Li et al., 2021, Han et al., 2022, Wang et al., 2022, Chai et al., 2024]，但可加性（Additivity）仍缺乏关注。 具体而言，可加性是指对于任意合作博弈 w_{1},w_{2}∈𝒢，均有 ϕ(w_{1}+w_{2})=ϕ(w_{1})+ϕ(w_{2})。 如果考虑 m 个可能的博弈，则有如下表达式：ϕ(∑_{i=1}^{m}w_{i})=∑_{i=1}^{m}ϕ(w_{i})，其中 w_{1},w_{2},…,w_{m}∈𝒢，且和 ∑_{i=1}^{m}w_{i} 可以看作由上述博弈复合而成的一个博弈。 线性性（Linearity）是比可加性更强的条件 [Dubey, 1975, Young, 1985]。 具体来说，线性性要求对所有 α_{i}∈ℝ，均有 ϕ(∑_{i=1}^{m}α_{i}w_{i})=∑_{i=1}^{m}α_{i}ϕ(w_{i})。 相比之下，可加性只要求在 α_{i}=1 时满足上式。 在我们的工作中，我们使用线性性公理来建立可加性公理，以适应我们的推导。

sents.en: Efficiency and Symmetry have been well investigated in the literature of multi-agent reinforcement learning [ Wang et al., 2020 , Li et al., 2021 , Han et al., 2022 , Wang et al., 2022 , Chai et al., 2024 ] , but Additivity still lacks attention.

paragraphs.en: Following discussion in Section 2.2 , we aim to restrict the state-specific cooperative game class to the superadditive game. By Proposition C.2 , we can conclude that k C ′ ≥ 0 k_{C}^{\prime}\geq 0 is a sufficient condition for v s v_{s} belonging to the superadditive game class. In other words, k C ′ ≥ 0 k_{C}^{\prime}\geq 0 is a key condition for reaching cooperation within a team of agents. However, k C ′ = 0 k_{C}^{\prime}=0 is a singularity condition, which leads to 0 for all state-specific cooperative games in values, with no actual meaning in practice. For this reason, we only choose k C ′ > 0 k_{C}^{\prime}>0 as the condition in our work.

This definition concerns the following situation: The number of agents increases when more exploration is conducted (i.e., C i C_{i} becomes larger in sizes), so more diverse agent types and behaviours emerge, resulting in that the estimation for the corresponding V ⁡ ( C i , s ) V(C_{i},s) has a higher variance. ( 6 ).

paragraphs.en: We first show in Lemma E.2 that, given s t = s s_{t}=s , the variance of the n n -step return is non-decreasing with the return horizon when the TD-error sequence ( Z n ) (Z_{n}) has non-negative autocovariances. Specifically, extending the horizon from n n to n + 1 n+1 adds the discounted TD-error term γ n ​ Z n + 1 \gamma^{n}Z_{n+1} , whose covariance with the existing return is non-negative. The return variance therefore increases strictly when this additional term has positive conditional variance and remains unchanged when it has zero conditional variance. Then, we make the coalition-variance monotonicity assumption in Assumption E.3 , which can be justified by Remark E.4 with evidence from the definition of the game structure for the NAHT and a verification experiment that partially supports Assumption E.3 . paragraphs.en: Because we are not allowed to change the number of agents in the existing environment (which is fixed with pre-trained teammates), we partially prove Assumption E.3 by showing the relation between the agent-type compositions and variances: We would like to show that when the number of agent-type compositions increases, the variance will not decrease. We design three settings denoted as Exp A, Exp B and Exp C to capture different numbers of agent-type compositions. The number of agent-type compositions in descent would be: Exp A ≥ Exp B ≥ Exp C \text{Exp A}\geq\text{Exp B}\geq\text{Exp C} , and the variance should be in the same order in expectation. 9 9 9 The agent type composition can be controlled by changing how the teammate types are sampled. We take the environment of 5v6 in SMAC as a testbed, where at most 5 agents in a team. Specifically, the original setting is sampling at most 4 teammates with various types, denoted as Exp A. In our new setting, we also fixed the cap of the number of teammates to sample as 3 and 2 teammates, denoted as Exp B and Exp C. In this way, the number of agent type compositions in descent would be: Exp A ≥ Exp B ≥ Exp C \text{Exp A}\geq\text{Exp B}\geq\text{Exp C} .
paragraphs.zh: 由于我们无法更改现有环境中智能体的数量（该数量由预训练队友固定），我们通过展示智能体类型组合与方差之间的关系来部分证明假设 E.3：我们想证明，当智能体类型组合的数量增加时，方差不会降低。 我们设计了三种设置，分别记为 Exp A、Exp B 和 Exp C，以捕捉不同数量的智能体类型组合。 智能体类型组合的数量呈递减关系：Exp A ≥ Exp B ≥ Exp C \text{Exp A}\geq\text{Exp B}\geq\text{Exp C}，且方差在期望上也应呈相同的顺序。9 9 9 智能体类型组合可以通过更改队友类型的采样方式来控制。 我们以 SMAC 中的 5v6 环境作为测试平台，其中每支队伍最多有 5 个智能体。 具体而言，原始设置是采样最多 4 个不同类型的队友，记为 Exp A。 在我们的新设置中，我们还分别将可采样队友数量的上限固定为 3 和 2 个队友，记为 Exp B 和 Exp C。 这样，智能体类型组合的数量呈递减关系：Exp A ≥ Exp B ≥ Exp C \text{Exp A}\geq\text{Exp B}\geq\text{Exp C}。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 7 , it can be observed that the relation between variances of three setups above is almost always as the following order: Exp A ≥ Exp B ≥ Exp C \text{Exp A}\geq\text{Exp B}\geq\text{Exp C} , over the whole training procedure (i.e., Exp A bounded above by Exp B, and Exp B bounded above by Exp C). 10 10 10 The reason why the variances of three settings finally converge to the same value is that models under all scenarios have reached at least an approximate solution to the optimal one. As we mentioned in the NAHT decomposition in Section 3 , there could be some unseen teammate compositions (with unseen behaviours) appearing during the training process. As the training procedure proceeds, there could be more diverse teammate compositions (including both seen and unseen teammates) that lead to various evaluation results, which directly leads to increasingly higher variances. The variances due to the diverse teammate compositions dominate the variance decrease led by the smaller search space of coalition values. The above result implies that the current approaches have not yet well learned to generalize to new teammates. However, it does not influence the contribution of this paper that improves on the existing methods, nor the conclusion we would like to show here. Instead, it demonstrates that this field is worth being investigated in the future. This result conforms to our expectation above and thus partially verifies the reasonableness of Assumption E.3 .

paragraphs.en: Now, recall that the Shapley value is uniquely characterized as the value function that satisfies the axioms of Efficiency, Symmetry and Additivity (Theorem 2.2 ). Since Linearity is a stronger condition than Additivity (indeed, setting all α i = 1 \alpha_{i}=1 in the definition of Linearity yields Additivity), any payoff allocation function that is Efficient, Symmetric, and Linear must coincide with the Shapley value. Therefore, the individual value functions V i V_{i} produced by the Shapley Machine are exactly the Shapley values for Dec-POMDPs. ∎

paragraphs.en: We now describe the details about implementing our proposed algorithm, referred to as Shapley Machine. In general, our algorithm is established based on the base algorithms POAM and IPPO, with modification to fulfil all the three axioms of the Shapley value: Efficiency, Linearity and Symmetry. Since the Symmetry axiom has been realised in POAM and IPPO, we only need to fulfil the Efficiency and Linearity axioms.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在介绍所提算法（称为 Shapley Machine）的实现细节。 总体而言，我们的算法基于基础算法 POAM 和 IPPO 构建，并进行了修改以满足 Shapley 值的全部三个公理：有效性、线性和对称性。 由于对称性公理已在 POAM 和 IPPO 中实现，我们只需满足有效性和线性公理。

paragraphs.en: Implementing the Linearity Axiom. In general, both POAM and IPPO have implemented TD( λ \lambda ), which does not strictly conform to the principle of the Linearity axiom. To address this problem, we change the TD( λ \lambda ) to TTD( λ \lambda ), where the number of n n -step return components is equal to the number of the non-empty coalition basis games, as informed by our theory. Note that in some scenarios the episode length is smaller than the number of non-empty coalition basis games. In these cases, the TTD( λ \lambda ) can be reduced to the TD( λ \lambda ) for the finite-horizon tasks with the episode length as T T , equivalently, the TTD( λ \lambda ) with m = T m=T . Alternatively, we can select a value of m m for each task based on extra conditions, which is left for the future work. In this paper, we set m = T m=T for the scenarios 8v9 and 10v11. For the 8v9 scenario, the episode length as 120 120 is not too far from the number of non-empty coalition basis games as 127 127 . For the 10v11 scenario, the episode length is 150 150 , while the number of non-empty coalition basis games is 511 511 .
paragraphs.zh: 实现线性公理。 一般来说，POAM 和 IPPO 都实现了 TD( λ \lambda )，这并不严格符合线性公理的原则。 为了解决这个问题，我们将 TD( λ \lambda ) 改为 TTD( λ \lambda )，其中 n n -步回报分量的数量等于非空联盟基博弈的数量，正如我们的理论所指出的。 请注意，在某些场景中，回合长度小于非空联盟基博弈的数量。 在这些情况下，TTD( λ \lambda ) 可以退化为 TD( λ \lambda )，用于回合长度为 T T 的有限时域任务，等价于 m = T m=T 的 TTD( λ \lambda )。 或者，我们可以基于额外条件为每个任务选择 m m 的值，这将留待未来的工作。 在本文中，我们对 8v9 和 10v11 场景设置 m = T m=T 。 对于 8v9 场景，回合长度 120 120 与非空联盟基博弈的数量 127 127 相差不大。 对于 10v11 场景，回合长度为 150 150 ，而非空联盟基博弈的数量为 511 511 。

paragraphs.en: Partial Observations. In practice, a controlled agent is only able to receive an observation, following the settings of Dec-POMDPs. Therefore, an agent is required to infer the state of the environment as an individual hidden state, through the history of observations. To this end, the policy and individual networks are realized by recurrent neural networks (RNNs) (e.g., GRUs [ Chung et al., 2014 ] ), where observations or representations transformed from observations are used as inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 部分可观测。 在实践中，受控的智能体只能接收观测，这遵循 Dec-POMDPs 的设定。 因此，智能体需要通过观测历史，将环境状态推断为个体隐状态。 为此，策略网络和个体网络由循环神经网络（RNNs）（例如 GRUs [Chung et al., 2014]）实现，其中观测或由观测变换得到的表示被用作输入。

sents.en: Partial Observations.
sents.zh: 部分可观测。

sents.en: In practice, a controlled agent is only able to receive an observation, following the settings of Dec-POMDPs.
sents.zh: 在实践中，受控的智能体只能接收观测，这遵循 Dec-POMDPs 的设定。

sents.en: Therefore, an agent is required to infer the state of the environment as an individual hidden state, through the history of observations.
sents.zh: 因此，智能体需要通过观测历史，将环境状态推断为个体隐状态。

sents.en: To this end, the policy and individual networks are realized by recurrent neural networks (RNNs) (e.g., GRUs [ Chung et al., 2014 ] ), where observations or representations transformed from observations are used as inputs.
sents.zh: 为此，策略网络和个体网络由循环神经网络（RNNs）（例如 GRUs [Chung et al., 2014]）实现，其中观测或由观测变换得到的表示被用作输入。

paragraphs.en: Implementation of the Symmetry Axiom. It can be observed that both POAM and IPPO are implemented by the sharing parameters, with agent ID to differentiate agent identities. Given an agent ID, its input is either individual observations or individual observations + teammate embeddings, where the teammate embeddings are transformed from individual observations through an encoder network.
paragraphs.zh: 对称性公理的实现。 可以观察到，POAM 和 IPPO 都是通过共享参数实现的，并使用智能体 ID 来区分智能体身份。 给定一个智能体 ID，其输入要么是个体观测，要么是个体观测加队友嵌入，其中队友嵌入是通过编码器网络从个体观测变换得到的。

sents.en: Implementation of the Symmetry Axiom.
sents.zh: 对称性公理的实现。

sents.en: It can be observed that both POAM and IPPO are implemented by the sharing parameters, with agent ID to differentiate agent identities.
sents.zh: 可以观察到，POAM 和 IPPO 都是通过共享参数实现的，并使用智能体 ID 来区分智能体身份。

sents.en: Given an agent ID, its input is either individual observations or individual observations + teammate embeddings, where the teammate embeddings are transformed from individual observations through an encoder network.
sents.zh: 给定一个智能体 ID，其输入要么是个体观测，要么是个体观测加队友嵌入，其中队友嵌入是通过编码器网络从个体观测变换得到的。

paragraphs.en: Estimation of Uncontrolled Agent Individual Values. We maintain all possible controlled agent policy and individual value networks as implemented by Wang et al. [2025] , given that the maximum number of controlled agents is known in the experimental settings of the NAHT, but only part of controlled agents in an episode can make decision. Thanks to the parameter sharing technique, this can be simply implemented by maintaining only a policy and/or an individual value network, with a set of agent IDs to represent and differentiate all possible controlled agents. During the training phase, the uncontrolled agents’ individual values are also required to implement the Efficiency axiom, as informed in Eq. ( 9 ), but they are unknown to the controlled agents; all training paradigms that we design should be based on the view of the controlled agents. To address this problem, the uncontrolled agents’ individual values are approximated by the maintained individual value function with the agent IDs of those inactive controlled agents, given that the observations of the uncontrolled agents are available for controlled agents during training.
paragraphs.zh: 对不受控智能体个体值的估计。 我们按照 Wang 等人所实现的方式，维护所有可能的受控智能体策略网络和个体值网络。 [2025]，因为在 NAHT 的实验设置中受控智能体的最大数量是已知的，但在一个回合中只有部分受控智能体会进行决策。 得益于参数共享技术，这可以简单地通过仅维护一个策略网络和/或一个个体值网络，以及一组用于表示和区分所有可能受控智能体的智能体 ID 来实现。 在训练阶段，还需要不受控智能体的个体值来实现如式 (9) 所述的效率公理。 但它们对受控智能体是未知的；我们设计的所有训练范式都应基于受控智能体的视角。 为解决这一问题，由于不受控智能体的观测在训练期间对受控智能体是可用的，我们利用那些非活跃受控智能体的智能体 ID，通过所维护的个体值函数来近似不受控智能体的个体值。

paragraphs.en: The MPE Predator Prey (MPE-PP) environment is a predator-prey task implemented within the Multi-Agent Particle Environment (MPE) framework. It simulates interactions within a two-dimensional space populated by two static obstacles, where three pursuer agents must cooperate to capture a single adversarial evader. A successful capture is defined as at least two pursuers simultaneously colliding with the evader, upon which the pursuers receive a positive reward of +1. If the capture is unsuccessful, no reward is granted. This environment is designed to test the ability of agents to coordinate under spatial and dynamic constraints. The length of an episode is T = 100 T=100 ,

paragraphs.en: The StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC) serves as a benchmark suite for evaluating CMARL algorithms in partially observable settings. Built on top of the StarCraft II game engine, SMAC presents a variety of micromanagement tasks where each agent (e.g., a Marine or Stalker) operates based on limited local observations and must coordinate actions with teammates to overcome enemy units. In this work, we focus on four specific SMAC scenarios: 5v6 : Five allied Marines versus six enemy Marines, 8v9 : Eight allied Marines versus nine enemy Marines, 10v11 : Ten allied Marines versus eleven enemy Marines, 3s5z : Three allied Stalkers versus five enemy Zealots. At each timestep, agents receive a shaped reward proportional to the damage they inflict on opponents, along with bonus rewards of 10 points for each enemy defeated and 200 points for achieving overall victory by eliminating all adversaries. The total return is normalized so that the maximum achievable return in each scenario is 20. The action space in SMAC is discrete, enabling each agent to choose actions such as attacking a particular enemy, moving in a specific direction, or remaining idle. The length of an episode varies across different scenarios: 3sv5z with T = 250 T=250 , 5v6 with T = 70 T=70 , 8v9 with T = 120 T=120 and 10v11 with T = 150 T=150 .
paragraphs.zh: 星际争霸多智能体挑战赛（SMAC）是一个用于在部分可观测环境下评估CMARL算法的基准测试套件。 SMAC构建于《星际争霸II》游戏引擎之上，提供了多种微观管理任务，其中每个智能体（例如枪兵或追猎者）基于有限的局部观测进行操作，并且必须与队友协调行动以击败敌方单位。 在本工作中，我们关注四个特定的SMAC场景：5v6：五名友方枪兵对抗六名敌方枪兵，8v9：八名友方枪兵对抗九名敌方枪兵，10v11：十名友方枪兵对抗十一名敌方枪兵，3s5z：三名友方追猎者对抗五名敌方狂热者。 在每个时间步，智能体会获得与其对对手造成的伤害成正比的塑形奖励，此外每击败一个敌人可获得10点的额外奖励，而通过消灭所有敌人取得整体胜利则可获得200点的额外奖励。 总回报经过归一化处理，使每个场景中可获得的最大回报为20。 SMAC中的动作空间是离散的，使每个智能体能够选择诸如攻击某个特定敌人、朝特定方向移动或保持空闲等动作。 回合长度因场景而异：3s5z为T=250，5v6为T=70，8v9为T=120，10v11为T=150。

paragraphs.en: For in-distribution evaluation, the mean return (or winrate) is computed over E E randomly sampled episodes. In each episode, we form a joint policy π ( ℳ ) \pi^{(\mathcal{M})} by sampling N N agents uniformly from 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and the remaining M − N M-N agents from 𝒰 \mathcal{U} . For the out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation, the M–N score [ Wang et al., 2025 ] is applied. Given a set of controllable agents 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and uncontrolled agents 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , the M–N score measures how well mixed teams of these agents cooperate in the NAHT setting. The score is computed exhaustively by changing the number of controllable agents included in the team. Specifically, for each N ∈ { 1 , … , M − 1 } N\in\{1,\dots,M-1\} , we form a joint policy π ( ℳ ) \pi^{(\mathcal{M})} by sampling N N agents uniformly from 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and the remaining M − N M-N agents from 𝒰 \mathcal{U} . The mixed teams are then evaluated on the task for E E episodes. This procedure yields ( M − 1 ) ⋅ E (M-1)\cdot E returns (or winrates) in total, whose average defines the M–N score.
paragraphs.zh: 对于分布内评估，平均回报（或胜率）是在 E 个随机采样的回合上计算的。 在每个回合中，我们通过从 𝒞 中均匀采样 N 个智能体，并从 𝒰 中采样其余 M−N 个智能体，来构成联合策略 π^(ℳ)。 对于分布外（OOD）评估，采用 M–N 分数 [Wang et al., 2025]。 给定一组可控智能体 𝒞 和不受控智能体 𝒰，M–N 分数衡量这些智能体组成的混合团队在 NAHT 设定下协作的好坏程度。 该分数通过穷举改变纳入团队的可控智能体数量来计算。 具体而言，对于每个 N∈{1,…,M−1}，我们通过从 𝒞 中均匀采样 N 个智能体，并从 𝒰 中采样其余 M−N 个智能体，来构成联合策略 π^(ℳ)。 随后，这些混合团队在任务上进行 E 个回合的评估。 该流程总共产生 (M−1)·E 个回报（或胜率），其平均值即定义为 M–N 分数。

paragraphs.en: The training procedure of the NAHT process is briefly introduced here. For more details, please refer to Wang et al. [2025] . For each scenario (e.g. MPE, 3sv5z, 5v6, 8v9 and 10v11), there are five groups of pretrained agents (e.g. IQL, MAPPO, VDN, QMIX and IPPO) acting as the uncontrolled agents. Given that each task specifies a fixed total number of agents M M , the number of controlled agents is N N . For each episode evaluation, the number of uncontrolled agents M − N M-N is sampled, and then a group of pretrained agents is sampled. 13 13 13 Note that this is still a special case of openness. For a varying number of controlled agents, the number of uncontrolled agents is also varied in correspondence, constrained by the total number of agents related to the task specifications. The distribution for all sampling procedures are modelled as the multinational distribution with no replacement. Each uncontrolled agent executes the greedy policy in both training and testing procedures. In contrast, each controlled agent executes the on-policy sampling via the parameterized policy during the training procedure, while the greedy policy during the testing procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 这里简要介绍NAHT过程的训练流程。 更多细节请参考Wang等 [2025]。对于每个场景（例如 MPE、3sv5z、5v6、8v9和10v11），有五组预训练智能体（例如 IQL、MAPPO、VDN、QMIX和IPPO）充当不受控智能体。 鉴于每个任务指定固定的智能体总数 M M ，受控智能体的数量为 N N 。 在每次回合评估中，采样不受控智能体的数量 M − N M-N ，然后采样一组预训练智能体。13 13 13 注意，这仍然是开放性的一种特殊情况。 对于受控智能体数量可变的情况，不受控智能体的数量也相应变化，并受任务规范所涉及的智能体总数的约束。 所有采样过程的分布被建模为无放回的多项分布。 每个不受控智能体在训练和测试过程中都执行贪心策略。 相比之下，每个受控智能体在训练过程中通过参数化策略执行在策略采样，而在测试过程中执行贪心策略。

paragraphs.en: Since our algorithm is established based on POAM and IPPO, most hyperparameter settings follow that in Wang et al. [2025] . First, the actors and critics are implemented in recurrent neural networks, with full parameter sharing. Specifically, they are implemented by two fully connected layers followed by a GRU layer and an output layer. Each layer has 64 dimensions with a ReLU activation function, and layer normalization is applied. The encoder-decoder networks for inferring agent characteristics are also implemented in parameter sharing. The encoder is implemented by a GRU layer, followed by a fully connected layer with a ReLU activation function and an output layer. The decoder is implemented by two fully connected layers with ReLU activation functions, followed by an output layer. Adam Optimizer is used to train all models. The detailed hyperparameters for experiments are shown in Tables 1 and 2 . For the scenarios such as MPE, 3sv5z and 5v6, the values of m m are set as the number of non-empty coalition basis games. For the scenarios such as 8v9 and 10v11, the values of m m are simply set as the length of an episode (see Appendix H.1 for more details). Note that the term ∑ j ≠ i ( V j ​ ( s t ) − γ ​ V j ​ ( s t + 1 ) ) \sum_{j\neq i}\left(V_{j}(s_{t})-\gamma V_{j}(s_{t+1})\right) in shaped rewards is standardised to match the scales of standardised rewards. To stabilize learning in large-scale scenarios, we add a value loss clip to Shapley Machine and Banzhaf Machine for POAM on both 8v9 and 10v11, and for IPPO on 10v11 only.
paragraphs.zh: 由于我们的算法是基于 POAM 和 IPPO 建立的，因此大多数超参数设置遵循 Wang et al. [2025]。 首先，执行器与评论器均以循环神经网络实现，并采用完全参数共享。 具体而言，它们由两个全连接层、一个 GRU 层和一个输出层实现。 每层维度为 64 并使用 ReLU 激活函数，同时应用了层归一化。 用于推断智能体特征的编码器-解码器网络同样以参数共享方式实现。 编码器由一个 GRU 层实现，其后是一个带 ReLU 激活函数的全连接层和一个输出层。 解码器由两个带 ReLU 激活函数的全连接层实现，其后是一个输出层。 所有模型均使用 Adam 优化器进行训练。 实验的详细超参数见表 1 和表 2。 对于 MPE、3sv5z 和 5v6 等场景，m m 的值被设为非空联盟基础博弈的数量。 对于 8v9 和 10v11 等场景，m m 的值则简单地被设为一条回合的长度（更多细节见附录 H.1）。 注意，塑形奖励中的 ∑ j ≠ i ( V j ​ ( s t ) − γ ​ V j ​ ( s t + 1 ) ) \sum_{j\neq i}\left(V_{j}(s_{t})-\gamma V_{j}(s_{t+1})\right) 项经过标准化处理，以与标准化奖励的尺度相匹配。 为在大规模场景中稳定学习，我们在 8v9 和 10v11 上为 POAM 的 Shapley Machine 与 Banzhaf Machine，且仅在 10v11 上为 IPPO，添加了价值损失裁剪。

sents.zh: 解码器由两个带 ReLU 激活函数的全连接层实现，其后是一个输出层。

sents.en: Adam Optimizer is used to train all models.

paragraphs.en: We now discuss the phenomenon observed from the performance under stochastic policy exploration during training. Discussing this phenomenon is meaningful: When a machine learning algorithm is deployed and has to adapt to real-world environments through online learning due to the mismatch between simulators and real-world environments, it is expected that random exploration diminishes rapidly over time to avoid the damage on real-world environments (e.g. physical systems).
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在讨论在训练过程中随机策略探索所表现出的现象。 讨论这一现象是有意义的：当机器学习算法被部署后，由于模拟器与真实环境之间的不匹配而必须通过在线学习来适应真实环境时，可以预期随机探索会随时间迅速减少，以避免对真实环境（例如物理系统）造成损害。

sents.zh: 讨论这一现象是有意义的：当机器学习算法被部署后，由于模拟器与真实环境之间的不匹配而必须通过在线学习来适应真实环境时，可以预期随机探索会随时间迅速减少，以避免对真实环境（例如物理系统）造成损害。

paragraphs.en: Recall that the PPO family algorithms implement exploration by the natural stochastic policy sampling from the learned policy distribution and maximizing policy entropy. As seen from Figure 8 , either Shapley Machine or Banzhaf Machine can outperform their base algorithm counterparts with a large margin. The reasons are as follows: As shown in Figure 9 , policy entropy decreases rapidly over the course of training (except for the IPPO implementation on 3sv5z, which underperforms due to incompatibility between IPPO and the task). This indicates that the learned policies become more deterministic than those of the base algorithms, despite all methods being optimized with an entropy-maximization objective. A possible explanation for this phenomenon is illustrated in Figure 10 : The critic losses of Shapley and Banzhaf Machines decrease faster than that of their base algorithm counterparts. This provides evidence for the advantage of structured individual value functions under our proposed axiomatic framework.
paragraphs.zh: 回顾一下，PPO 系列算法通过从学习到的策略分布中进行自然的随机策略采样并最大化策略熵来实现探索。 从图 8 可以看出，无论是 Shapley Machine 还是 Banzhaf Machine，都能以较大幅度超越其对应的基础算法。 原因如下：如图 9 所示，策略熵在训练过程中迅速下降（IPPO 在 3sv5z 上的实现除外，由于 IPPO 与该任务不兼容，其表现不佳）。 这表明，尽管所有方法都是以熵最大化目标进行优化的，但学习到的策略比基础算法的策略更加确定。 对这一现象的一种可能解释如图 10 所示：Shapley Machine 和 Banzhaf Machine 的评论家损失比其对应基础算法的评论家损失下降得更快。 这为我们提出的公理化框架下结构化个体价值函数的优势提供了证据。

paragraphs.en: We now demonstrate the association between the changing of the shaping rewards and the response of corresponding testing returns. As shown in Figure 13 , the shaped reward increases in the beginning and then gradually reaches a plateau. The efficiency loss also exhibits the similar phenomenon. As shown in Figure 14 , it can be observed that when instability happens during training as evidenced by the sudden changes of test returns, the shaped reward can consistently manifest this situation (as highlighted in red vertical dashed lines). This feature is crucial in the NAHT, since it could be a frequent and typical case when an unseen agent appears in the environment, which may perturb the training stability. This justifies the effectiveness of the shaping rewards ϕ i ​ ( R t ) \phi_{i}(R_{t}) we propose to fulfil the Efficiency axiom. More importantly, this highlights the importance and necessity of the Efficiency axiom to perceive and measure the changing of environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在展示塑造奖励的变化与相应测试回报的响应之间的关联。 如图13所示，塑造奖励在开始时上升，然后逐渐达到平稳状态。 效率损失也表现出类似的现象。 如图14所示，可以观察到，当训练期间出现不稳定（表现为测试回报的突然变化）时，塑造奖励能够一致地反映这种情况（如红色垂直虚线所示）。 这一特征在NAHT中至关重要，因为不可见的智能体出现在环境中可能是一种频繁且典型的情况，这可能会扰乱训练的稳定性。 这证明了我提出的用于满足效率公理的塑造奖励 ϕ i ​ ( R t ) \phi_{i}(R_{t}) 的有效性。 更重要的是，这凸显了效率公理在感知和衡量环境变化方面的重要性和必要性。

paragraphs.en: We also conducted experiments on evaluating the OOD performance of Shapley Machine and Banzhaf Machine on the base algorithm IPPO (IPPO-NAHT). As seen from Figure 11(a) , Banzhaf Machine is competitive to Shapley Machine on dealing with unseen conventions. Although it seems that the result is opposite to the conclusion drawn from the POAM related results, the underlying reason could be the general weaker performance of IPPO than POAM due to the lack of agent modelling, as shown in Figure 15 . This could inhibit the full capability of Shapley Machine. As seen from Figure 11(b) , the general performance of Banzhaf Machine is better than Shapley Machine. This is consistent with the conclusion drawn from the POAM related results. In Figure 12 , we show additional comparisons between algorithms: POAM vs. IPPO, SM-POAM vs. SM-IPPO and BM-POAM vs. BM-IPPO. We find no strong evidence that the axioms are sensitive to the choice of base algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还在基础算法 IPPO（IPPO-NAHT）上进行了实验，评估 Shapley Machine 和 Banzhaf Machine 的 OOD 性能。 从图 11(a) 可以看出，Banzhaf Machine 在应对未见过的约定方面与 Shapley Machine 相当。 虽然这一结果看起来与从 POAM 相关结果得出的结论相反，但其根本原因可能是如图 15 所示，由于缺乏智能体建模，IPPO 的整体性能弱于 POAM。 这可能会抑制 Shapley Machine 的全部能力。 从图 11(b) 可以看出，Banzhaf Machine 的整体性能优于 Shapley Machine。 这与从 POAM 相关结果得出的结论一致。 在图 12 中，我们展示了算法之间的额外比较：POAM 与 IPPO、SM-POAM 与 SM-IPPO 以及 BM-POAM 与 BM-IPPO。 我们没有发现强有力的证据表明这些公理对基础算法的选择敏感。

paragraphs.en: During our repeated trials, we observe that the performance of Shapley Machine is not stable in large-scale scenarios (e.g. 8v9 and 10v11), compared with in small-scale scenarios (e.g. MPE-PP, 3sv5z and 5v6). We now analyze the potential reason behind this phenomenon. As observed from Figures 16 and 17 , it can be confirmed that the instability of shaped rewards is the key reason to cause the instability of learning procedure for large-scale scenarios. According to the functionality of shaping rewards discussed in Appendix I.2 , we hypothesize that the instability could be caused by the unstable changing of value difference in the shaping reward: ∑ j ≠ i ( V j ​ ( s t ) − γ ​ V j ​ ( s t + 1 ) ) \sum_{j\neq i}\left(V_{j}(s_{t})-\gamma V_{j}(s_{t+1})\right) . Specifically, when the number of agents increases, the accumulating prediction error of individual value functions will be amplified.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们多次重复试验中，我们观察到与在小规模场景（例如 MPE-PP、3sv5z 和 5v6）中相比，Shapley Machine 的性能在大规模场景（例如 8v9 和 10v11）中并不稳定。 我们现在分析这一现象背后的潜在原因。 从图 16 和图 17 中可以观察到，可以确认塑形奖励的不稳定是导致大规模场景学习过程不稳定的关键原因。 根据附录 I.2 中讨论的塑形奖励的功能，我们假设这种不稳定性可能是由塑形奖励中价值差的不稳定变化引起的：∑ j ≠ i ( V j ​ ( s t ) − γ ​ V j ​ ( s t + 1 ) ) \sum_{j\neq i}\left(V_{j}(s_{t})-\gamma V_{j}(s_{t+1})\right) 。 具体来说，当智能体数量增加时，各价值函数的累积预测误差将被放大。

sents.en: During our repeated trials, we observe that the performance of Shapley Machine is not stable in large-scale scenarios (e.g. 8v9 and 10v11), compared with in small-scale scenarios (e.g. MPE-PP, 3sv5z and 5v6).
sents.zh: 在我们多次重复试验中，我们观察到与在小规模场景（例如 MPE-PP、3sv5z 和 5v6）中相比，Shapley Machine 的性能在大规模场景（例如 8v9 和 10v11）中并不稳定。

sents.en: We now analyze the potential reason behind this phenomenon.
sents.zh: 我们现在分析这一现象背后的潜在原因。

sents.en: As observed from Figures 16 and 17 , it can be confirmed that the instability of shaped rewards is the key reason to cause the instability of learning procedure for large-scale scenarios.
sents.zh: 从图 16 和图 17 中可以观察到，可以确认塑形奖励的不稳定是导致大规模场景学习过程不稳定的关键原因。

sents.en: According to the functionality of shaping rewards discussed in Appendix I.2 , we hypothesize that the instability could be caused by the unstable changing of value difference in the shaping reward: ∑ j ≠ i ( V j ​ ( s t ) − γ ​ V j ​ ( s t + 1 ) ) \sum_{j\neq i}\left(V_{j}(s_{t})-\gamma V_{j}(s_{t+1})\right) .
sents.zh: 根据附录 I.2 中讨论的塑形奖励的功能，我们假设这种不稳定性可能是由塑形奖励中价值差的不稳定变化引起的：∑ j ≠ i ( V j ​ ( s t ) − γ ​ V j ​ ( s t + 1 ) ) \sum_{j\neq i}\left(V_{j}(s_{t})-\gamma V_{j}(s_{t+1})\right) 。

sents.en: Specifically, when the number of agents increases, the accumulating prediction error of individual value functions will be amplified.
sents.zh: 具体来说，当智能体数量增加时，各价值函数的累积预测误差将被放大。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate the above issue, we have added the value loss clip to stabilize the learning procedure of individual value functions for the large-scale scenarios such as 8v9 and 10v11. As seen from Figure 3 , even with the value loss clip the instability of SM-IPPO is still out of control. This could be the cascading effect caused by the lack of agent modelling in contrast to SM-POAM, the instability of which is far beyond the capability of value loss clip. This reflects the value of agent modelling in POAM for tackling the large-scale multi-agent scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解上述问题，我们加入了价值损失裁剪，以稳定大规模场景（如8v9和10v11）下各个价值函数的学习过程。 如图3所示，即使使用了价值损失裁剪，SM-IPPO的不稳定性仍然失控。 与SM-POAM相比，这可能是由于缺乏智能体建模而引发的级联效应，其不稳定性远超价值损失裁剪的能力范围。 这体现了POAM中智能体建模在应对大规模多智能体场景时的价值。

sents.en: To mitigate the above issue, we have added the value loss clip to stabilize the learning procedure of individual value functions for the large-scale scenarios such as 8v9 and 10v11.
sents.zh: 为了缓解上述问题，我们加入了价值损失裁剪，以稳定大规模场景（如8v9和10v11）下各个价值函数的学习过程。

sents.en: As seen from Figure 3 , even with the value loss clip the instability of SM-IPPO is still out of control.
sents.zh: 如图3所示，即使使用了价值损失裁剪，SM-IPPO的不稳定性仍然失控。

sents.en: This could be the cascading effect caused by the lack of agent modelling in contrast to SM-POAM, the instability of which is far beyond the capability of value loss clip.
sents.zh: 与SM-POAM相比，这可能是由于缺乏智能体建模而引发的级联效应，其不稳定性远超价值损失裁剪的能力范围。

sents.en: This reflects the value of agent modelling in POAM for tackling the large-scale multi-agent scenarios.
sents.zh: 这体现了POAM中智能体建模在应对大规模多智能体场景时的价值。

paragraphs.en: As seen from Figure 18 , the learning procedures with the value loss clip for the SM-POAM apparently perform more stably than those without. This verifies our initial hypothesis. Because this strategy will slow down and even hinder the performance for the other three scenarios, we have not posted this as a common strategy. We believe this deserves further investigation in the future before any claims can be made about its general performance.
paragraphs.zh: 从图18可以看出，对SM-POAM使用价值损失裁剪的学习过程明显比不使用时更加稳定。 这验证了我们最初的假设。 由于该策略会减慢甚至阻碍其他三种场景的性能，我们没有将其作为通用策略提出。 我们认为这值得在未来进一步研究，之后才能对其总体性能做出任何论断。

sents.zh: 我们认为这值得在未来进一步研究，之后才能对其总体性能做出任何论断。

paragraphs.en: We report the results on unseen conventions and agent types for each specific number of controlled agents N N in Figures 19 - 22 , by fixing the N value in the M–N score. We would like to highlight that the NAHT problem is a far more difficult task to deal with than the CMARL problem. As a result, our work is only a starting point in this direction, and we believe that the potential stability issue is due to the lack of more exact axioms tailored to the concrete task to face. However, following the framework and principle we develop in this work, this can be improved by considering more axioms that we do not cover in this work, from either the game-theoretical perspective or the physical world.
